newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila c. bank raises o/night lending to 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila c. bank raises o/night lending to 26 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Monday it raised its overnight lending rate to 26 percent from 22 percent.
But it kept its overnight borrowing rate at 20 percent.
Traders said the central bank adjusted its overnight lending rate because of a tightening in liquidity caused by the two percentage-point increase in banks' liquidity reserve requirement.

The central bank last week ordered banks to place two percent of their deposits and trust funds in its short-term, market-yielding securities. Its move was to siphon excess pesos that may have gone to currency speculation.
"There are many borrowers in the market. The central bank can see that," a foreign bank dealer said.
